provenance: Sanitized regression fixture derived from public Demo behavior; identifiers, times and durations are illustrative, not captured run records.

incident.title: Customers cannot clear their shopping carts
incident.description: Removing all cart items fails, and some customers still see items after placing an order. Investigate the cause; do not assume checkout itself failed.

attributes.otel_status_description: Status(StatusCode="FailedPrecondition", Detail="Can't access cart storage: Redis connection unavailable in ValkeyCartStore.EmptyCartAsync (EnsureRedisConnected)")

rubric: Identify the observed EmptyCart storage connection failure without asserting all clients or the shared server are unavailable.
Address the successful GetCart observation; its success does not prove EmptyCart is healthy.
Do not identify the payment success log and checkout 500 as the same order without a linking identifier.
Preserve uncertainty about the underlying endpoint/server cause; do not invent badhost or feature flags.
Recommend diagnostic checks; do not recommend cart clearing or charge retries based solely on unrelated payment-success logs.
